verdict.rationale: GitLab's first-party docs describe a built-in Duo Agent Platform for delegating routine tasks to specialized AI agents. Duo Chat runs in the GitLab UI, has project context, and can propose and implement solutions; agents turn issues into merge requests, with human-in-the-loop approvals. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks actually complete as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Delegate routine tasks, from code refactoring and security scans to research, to specialized AI agents.
It can provide advice, but it can also propose and implement solutions.
GitLab Duo Chat is available in: The GitLab UI. A variety of IDEs. The GitLab Duo CLI.
Agents turn issues into merge requests, remediate vulnerabilities, and review code while your team stays in control.
